adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` using `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb), and the migration creating `embeddable_hosts` does not add any index on `host` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb). Without an index, lookups like `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (used in EmbedController and TopicRetriever) will require scanning the table; and even if a plain btree index were added on `host`, the `lower(host)` expression would not use it unless you normalize stored values or add an expression index. This is a concrete performance/maintainability issue introduced by the change, but not a correctness/security defect by itself.
